meaning:
1) to long for, yearn for, long after
1a) (Qal) to long for
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to long for (deeply)
1b2) being longed for (participle)

elsewhere.note: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”
You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
